phases.deliverable: Read-only client access and host lifecycle
Standing envelope, quotas and event supervision
Evidence, research depth and independent verification

scenarios.trigger: Crash after attempt acceptance but before canonical-task acknowledgement; replay the outbox twice.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one attempt and one canonical transition; missing acknowledgement blocks dependent work; no competing task registry.

scenarios.trigger: Start two leaders; crash the winner between reservation and launch; submit an old-fence result.
scenarios.expected: One launch authority; uncertain launch stays charged and held; old fence cannot mutate or publish.

scenarios.trigger: On the actual Windows account, test boot, sign-out, lock, closing every editor, WSL shutdown, sleep and wake.
scenarios.expected: Record which startup modes work; healthy host recovers within target; outage is explicit; no duplicate controller; sleep is never called uptime.

scenarios.trigger: Attach Cursor and Codex simultaneously through stdio; disconnect one and reconnect with an expired event cursor.
scenarios.expected: Both observe the same instance/revision; work survives disconnect; cursor gap triggers snapshot; stale client cannot mutate.

scenarios.trigger: Spoof Owner in the request body, cross projects, replay an idempotency key with a different body, and revoke a grant.
scenarios.expected: Transport-bound identities prevail; forbidden mutations fail; identical retries return one receipt; changed bodies conflict; revoked grants fail.

scenarios.trigger: Two clients claim one task and offer five children each; then a leased client disappears and returns late.
scenarios.expected: One task lease; every admitted child has a counted reservation; unknown cleanup retains holds; late results cannot advance newer incarnation.

scenarios.trigger: Offer a new agent while the frozen native campaign owns the pool lock.
scenarios.expected: Offer is acknowledged and queued; plan bytes unchanged; no second campaign or bypass; queued state visible until next admitted batch.

scenarios.trigger: Submit packets without parent, requirement, exact source, gate or tool scope; offer v2 work under a v3-only grant.
scenarios.expected: Invalid/out-of-scope packets refuse before inference; valid v3 packet preserves every binding and declared oracle.

scenarios.trigger: Return two non-novel accepted research filings, a meaningful negative result and a long admitted experiment.
scenarios.expected: Repeated lane suspends for re-scoping; negative evidence may close the claim; long work is not killed merely for sparse chatter.

scenarios.trigger: Submit self-approved code, forged PASS, a changed candidate, missing tool receipts and a dissenting independent review.
scenarios.expected: None bypass gates; exact independent evidence required; original dissent retained; no vote or silent verifier downgrade.

scenarios.trigger: Offer more local/remote agents during command saturation, low memory, stale quota, retained holds and review backlog.
scenarios.expected: Admission uses binding global/host/account constraints; four command slots remain; verifier/control reserve survives; excess offers receive reasons.

scenarios.trigger: Keep workers healthy without events, then deliver the same failed-gate event repeatedly while advisor quota is exhausted.
scenarios.expected: Idle model dispatches zero; duplicates coalesce; one durable blocker; safe existing work continues but judgment-dependent actions wait.

scenarios.trigger: Cross a quota reset and standing-grant expiry; restart with old plan/reset IDs, rollback the clock and retain an unknown attempt.
scenarios.expected: No extension of old batch; fresh plan only within valid grant after reconciliation; unknown charges persist; uncertain clock stops admission.

scenarios.trigger: Connect two clients on one Codex account plus Cognition; remove a quota field and attempt paid fallback/reset redemption.
scenarios.expected: Shared accounts aggregate once; account windows remain distinct; unknown telemetry refuses affected admission; paid fallback and resets stay disabled.

scenarios.trigger: Inject prelaunch rejection, postlaunch timeout, malformed completed filing and repeated provider errors.
scenarios.expected: At most two bounded known-failure retries; no uncertain replay; route backoff/circuit is visible; restart does not erase attempts or holds.

scenarios.trigger: Compact a task containing revoked authority, negative results, a staged diff and an uncertain effect; change source before resume.
scenarios.expected: Original evidence recoverable; revocation/unknown survive; stale source/lease refuses resume; task identity and remaining budget persist.

scenarios.trigger: Integrate two overlapping proposals and move the integration base after first verification.
scenarios.expected: Serial composition; conflicts surfaced; exact combined gate/review rerun; prior PASS cannot certify new bytes.

scenarios.trigger: Lose push and PR acknowledgements, then retry; propose master merge; fill the three-candidate review queue.
scenarios.expected: Remote intent reconciles to one review branch/PR; no default merge; candidate cap stops more integration and preserves useful review work.

scenarios.trigger: Issue Owner Stop/PAUSE while launch, artifact adoption and publication race; attempt contributor resume.
scenarios.expected: Fresh fencing prevents new effects; owned cleanup observed separately; contributor cannot resume; awareness remains and delivery obeys PAUSE.

scenarios.trigger: Saturate build/worker queues while querying status, subscribing to events and issuing authorized Stop.
scenarios.expected: Control queue remains responsive within targets; last-observed state is marked stale on outage; acknowledgement never claims completed cleanup.

scenarios.trigger: After separate activation, run one pinned live SWE-2 job and independent verifier on the actual WSL host.
scenarios.expected: Exact identity/tool/receipt and cgroup cleanup evidence; no host writable mounts or credentials in worker artifacts; scale only after pass.

scenarios.trigger: Run a 72-hour authorized five-worker soak with outages, recovery, quota changes and continuous client access probes.
scenarios.expected: Host-awake availability at least 99.5%; zero integrity breaches; bounded spend; outages classified; requirements or falsifiable claims actually closed.

scenarios.trigger: Compare five versus eight total workers on matched pinned tasks with equal research depth and independent acceptance.
scenarios.expected: Measure full cost, reviewer time and escaped defects; expand only on higher verified throughput without quality regression; inconclusive retains five.

scenarios.trigger: Request live research sources or a build exceeding the offline 60-second command profile.
scenarios.expected: Declared profile refusal; reviewed source acquisition or separately qualified long-build route required; no host-shell escape or reduced test depth.

scenarios.trigger: GrokBot contributes using computer access and submits an uncontained desktop result.
scenarios.expected: Named authenticated identity and task scope required; result remains a proposal until isolated import and independent verification; no implicit Owner authority.

scenarios.trigger: Restore an interrupted ledger/artifact backup and simulate ext4 or D: exhaustion and a missing artifact.
scenarios.expected: No admitted duplicate/unknown effect; source/evidence gaps visible; admission stops with reserved closeout space; restore evidence binds actual bytes.
